what_this_is: Every song sitting in a musical bingo pack for which this repo holds no Australian chart placing, no countdown placing, and no place in the hand picked Pub Classics of 8 September. NOTHING HAS BEEN REMOVED. This is a list for Dean to read, not an instruction.
what_this_is_not: Proof a song is unknown. There is no ARIA weekly top 50 here and no airplay data at all, so a song that lived at number 30 for three months or that radio played to death without selling will be on this list.
read_this_first: Sexual Healing by Marvin Gaye is on this list, and so are Ace of Spades by Motorhead and Ring of Fire by Johnny Cash. None of them ever finished inside an Australian year-end top 25 and none of them has ever been forgotten. A song with no paperwork is not the same thing as a song nobody knows.
